answer: The protocol requires agents to reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as a digital meadow where exclusive task windows are anchored and verified by a central registrar. An auditor monitors the tide of incoming reservation requests to detect conflicting occupancy; any identity caught with overlapping commitments triggers an immediate slash. Reaching the summit of capacity, an honest agent pays for one slot, while 1,000 fake identities incur 1,000 times that cost.
